name: @getpopapi/n8n-nodes-pop-zoho
description: n8n custom node — maps POP API payload to Zoho Invoice / Zoho Books

scripts.postbuild: if [ -d "$HOME/.n8n/custom" ]; then ln -sf $(pwd)/dist/nodes/PopZohoInvoice/PopZohoInvoice.node.js $HOME/.n8n/custom/PopZohoInvoice.node.js && ln -sf $(pwd)/dist/credentials/ZohoInvoiceOAuth2Api.credentials.js $HOME/.n8n/custom/ZohoInvoiceOAuth2Api.credentials.js && ln -sf $(pwd)/dist/nodes/PopZohoInvoice/pop-zoho-invoice.svg $HOME/.n8n/custom/pop-zoho-invoice.svg; fi
